title: Make the Windows state-path relative-spelling cwd precondition explicit
outcome: Relative-spelling path controls explicitly validate their cwd versus manifest-root assumption or derive spellings from the actual cwd, so unsupported direct binary invocation fails with a clear precondition rather than an unexplained missing file.
acceptance: Relative spellings are derived from the actual cwd or preceded by a clear native/canonical cwd precondition; supported Cargo and launcher execution retains discriminating existing-entry checks.
No process-global cwd mutation, sleeps, retries or weaker guard assertions are introduced; relevant focused controls pass.
